input_references.role: Timestamped GPS cycling points linked by trajectory_id, including if_bike bike-lane annotation

metadata.goal: Find obvious cycling patterns in the city and exceptional cases if possible based on trajectories of different users.
metadata.category: Multi-user cycling route directness, partial bike-lane use, time-period destinations, and temperature-speed patterns
metadata.header: MTL Trajet: 14 Cycling Directness, Destination, and Temperature
metadata.dataset_description: Multi-user cycling trajectories with route directness, temperature, destination land use, time period, and timestamped GPS points; destination clusters are map-matched to Technopôle Angus, Mile End / Boulevard Saint-Laurent, and Parc du Canal-de-Lachine, and point records include a Boolean if_bike field for bike-lane presence.
metadata.metric_note: `route_directness_ratio` is path length divided by the straight-line origin-to-destination distance. `if_bike` is a Boolean point-level indicator that the GPS point lies on a bike-lane segment.
metadata.land_use_reference: Archived PUM2050 Affectatio polygons (2025). Labels describe reference-map zoning at fixed endpoints, not surveyed activities at the time of travel.
metadata.motion_consistency_note: Point speed is the incoming segment GPS great-circle distance divided by elapsed time; the first point repeats the first outgoing segment speed. Earth radius: 6371.0088 km. Trip distance is the sum of these segment distances. avg_speed_kmh and mean_speed_kmh are total distance / elapsed time; avg_point_speed_kmh and point_speed_mean_kmh are unweighted means of the delivered point speeds. speed_cv is the population coefficient of variation of incoming segment speeds, excluding the duplicated first endpoint. trajectory_progress is point_index / (point_count - 1), not elapsed-time fraction. Timestamps and speed fields were reconstructed for internal consistency on 2026-10-09; GPS positions and insight wording were preserved. These are curated example records, not newly recovered observations.
